Situation: Corvale East holds 144 units of amiodarone hydrochloride 200 mg tablets with 9.8 days on hand. Corvale General holds 268.36 units with 17.9 days on hand. The drug is not on the FDA shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): The product label for NDC 71335194204 identifies Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) as the registered plant. FDA inspection 590126 ended 2009-06-11 and was classified Official Action Indicated with six observations including lack of a written stability program and complaint investigation deficiencies. A Warning Letter was issued 2010-04-08. Subsequent inspections from 2010 through 2026-07-16 have all been classified Voluntary Action Indicated.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is below the two-week target. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support a transfer without dropping below two weeks. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 58 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from A-S Medication Solutions if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Advagen Pharma Limited if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from American Health Packaging if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Aphena Pharma Solutions - Tennessee, LLC if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No action that assumes an FDA shortage declaration or allocation program.
